dict.Aceleași produse sau servicii cerute la: The same products or services asked from three suppliers: each row shows the lowest price (in green) and who gives it; below, the total of each offer, the missing prices and the terms (delivery, payment, warranty), on the right the lowest complete offer.
dict.Cel mai mic preț de pe fiecare rând iese: The lowest price on each row is shown in green; an offer with missing prices does not count as complete.
dict.Economia față de oferta completă: Saving compared to the complete offer
dict.Luând fiecare produs de la cel mai iefti: Buying each product from the cheapest
dict.Scrie numele furnizorilor în E1, F1 și G: Write the supplier names in E1, F1 and G1, then the unit price, without VAT.
